tour_type.morning: 🏰 Kalemegdan Fortress: Start your Belgrade adventure at the city’s legendary fortress — wide stone walls, shady paths, and a massive panorama where the Sava meets the Danube. It’s peaceful, iconic, and a perfect morning warm-up. → | 🗽 Victor Monument: The city’s classic symbol — standing tall with one of the best viewpoints in Belgrade. Great spot for your ‘hey, I’m above Belgrade’ photo moment. → | 🎖️ Military Museum: Nicely arranged displays of uniforms, objects and history from different eras — interesting, clear and easy to explore. → | 🚶‍♂️ Knez Mihailova Street: The city’s most famous pedestrian zone — street artists, old architecture, cute shops and a lively city vibe. A total Belgrade essential. → | ☕ Republic Square Café Break: Relax at a central café surrounded by museums, theaters and buzzing city life. Great place to chill and people-watch.
tour_type.afternoon: 🍷 Skadarlija Bohemian Quarter (atmosphere only): Step into Belgrade’s most charming old street — cobblestones, murals, vintage lanterns, and a timeless bohemian vibe. Calm during the day, magical in the evening. → | 🍽️ Serbian-Style Lunch: Hearty, homey and full of flavor — dishes like ćevapi, sarma, gibanica, prebranac, ajvar and veggie-friendly picks. Rustic atmosphere, warm service, comforting food. → | ⚡ Nikola Tesla Museum: Explore Tesla’s world — interactive elements, original items and inspiring stories about his genius. Super accessible even if you’re not a science expert. → | ⛪ St. Sava Temple: One of the largest Orthodox churches in the world — majestic outside, serene and impressive inside. Wide plateau, lots of space, perfect for a slow afternoon stroll.
tour_type.sunset: 🗼 Zemun Gardoš Tower Walk: Wander through narrow cobblestone lanes in old Zemun until you reach the historic Gardoš Tower — golden light, river breeze, boats, rooftops and the Danube stretching far away. Peaceful, charming, and insanely photogenic.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Savamala & Beton Hala (non-alcoholic friendly): Modern riverfront spots with stylish cafés, soft lights and great water views. Some venues have age restrictions, but many offer teen-friendly options like fresh juices, lemonades, smoothies, iced teas and great coffee. Perfect for relaxing by the river, people-watching and enjoying Belgrade’s contemporary vibe — safely and calmly.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Kalemegdan Fortress → Victor Monument → Military Museum → Knez Mihailova Street → Republic Square café.; Afternoon: Skadarlija (bohemian streets) → Serbian lunch → Nikola Tesla Museum → St. Sava Temple.; Sunset: Gardoš Tower golden-hour view.; Night: Savamala & Beton Hala (non-alcoholic cafés & relaxed riverfront stroll).

ideas: 🌊 Riverside Walks (Dorćol & Zemun): * Spring + river = perfect combination. | In Dorćol, you can enjoy a peaceful walk along the Danube, bike paths and cafes with deck chairs. In Zemun — a completely different vibe: a walk along the quay, seagulls, a view of Gardoš and that light “small town within a city” feeling. Ideal for sunbathing, ice cream and taking photos.

🌿 Botanical Garden Tour (Jevremovac): * This is a spring jackpot: paths among flower alleys, a greenhouse with exotic plants, and tons of greenery all around you. Peaceful, relaxing, and a great place for a mini getaway from the city crowds — plus it looks great in photos.

☕ Outdoor Cafés in Vračar: * Kada proleće grune, Vračar postane jedno veliko dvorište. Kafići izbacuju bašte, ljudi sede napolju, pije se limunada, hladna kafa ili sok od zove, a kroz ulice se oseća prvi pravi topli vazduh. Idealno za kratku pauzu posle šetnje ili bleju sa ekipom.

🏖️ Ada Ciganlija Beach Day: | Belgrade’s “city seaside”! You can swim, rent a paddleboard, bike around the lake, or just chill on the shore. Lots of shade, snack spots, and a full-on summer vibe without leaving the city.

🌅 Danube & Sava Evening Walks: | When the heat finally calms down, the riverbanks come alive. Cool breezes, long paths for walking, great sunset views, and a super relaxed atmosphere. Perfect for unwinding after a hot day.

🍦 Gelato in the City Center: | Grab an ice cream in Knez Mihailova or around Republic Square and enjoy a sweet break while wandering through the historic streets. Summer survival kit = gelato + shade + slow stroll.
🌳 Kalemegdan Shade Strolls: | The fortress park is full of trees, quiet corners, and breezy viewpoints. Ideal for escaping the heat while still exploring one of the most iconic places in the city.

🍁 Skadarlija Stone Street Walks: | Skadarlija in autumn feels extra magical: colorful leaves on old cobblestones, warm lights from historic buildings, and that classic bohemian charm. Perfect for slow walks and soaking up the atmosphere.

🏛️ Museum Visits: | Fall is a great time to explore Belgrade’s museums — from history and art to science and culture. Quiet halls, interesting exhibits, and a comfy escape from chilly weather. Ideal for curious minds.

☕ Warm Pastries & Coffee in Dorćol Cafés: | Dorćol’s small cafés are perfect for autumn coziness. Fresh pastries, warm drinks, gentle music, and big windows where you can watch the leaves fall. A total comfort vibe for a cool day.

locations: ✨ Knez Mihailova Street Winter Market: | A festive stretch of wooden booths, lights, and holiday decorations along Belgrade’s main pedestrian street. You’ll find handmade ornaments, warm snacks, crafts, and that cheerful winter atmosphere that makes the whole street glow.

🎄 Republic Square Holiday Stalls: | The central square turns into a cozy holiday corner with small stalls offering gifts, seasonal treats, and local crafts. Bright lights, music, and a lively winter vibe make it a perfect stop during a holiday stroll.

places: 🏰 Kalemegdan Fortress: | A centuries-old fortress overlooking the confluence of the Sava and Danube rivers. It combines ancient walls, old gates, scenic viewpoints, and layers of history from Romans, Ottomans, Austro-Hungarians, and more. A perfect open-air time-travel spot.

🏛️ National Museum: | Belgrade’s main museum, home to archaeology, medieval art, and modern history exhibits. You’ll find everything from ancient artifacts to famous paintings, giving a full overview of Serbia’s cultural and historical development in one place.

⭐ Museum of Yugoslavia: | A fascinating look into the 20th century: everyday objects, political history, cultural items, and stories from the Yugoslav era. The museum offers a unique perspective on how people lived, worked, and shaped society during that period.
what_to_get: 🏺 Historical Replicas: | Small items inspired by real artifacts from Serbia’s past — miniature statues, old-style ornaments, traditional symbols, or replicas of objects found in museums. They’re great souvenirs for anyone who wants to bring home a little piece of history in a decorative, meaningful form.

🏛️ Museum-Themed Souvenirs: | Fun and educational keepsakes connected to Belgrade’s museums: postcards, notebooks, magnets, bookmarks, and items featuring famous exhibits or artworks. They’re perfect for history and culture fans who want something that reminds them of their museum visit.

places: 🖼️ Contemporary Art Museum (Ušće): | A bright, modern space showcasing Serbian and regional contemporary art — paintings, installations, multimedia works, and experimental pieces. The building itself is iconic, with huge windows looking over the rivers. Perfect for anyone who enjoys bold creativity and fresh perspectives.

🎭 KC Grad: | A cultural hub in Savamala known for exhibitions, design markets, workshops, performances, and creative events. It’s a dynamic community space where young artists, designers, and musicians often present their work. (Note: Some events take place in bar-like settings, but many are open cultural programs suitable for all ages.)

🎨 Dorćol Art Studios: | Hidden creative corners in one of Belgrade’s artsiest neighborhoods. Small studios where local painters, illustrators, sculptors, and designers work — and sometimes open their doors to visitors. Great for discovering unique pieces and seeing art 'in the making'.
what_to_get: 🎨 Local Illustrator Prints: | High-quality prints created by local artists, often showing Belgrade streets, characters, or imaginative scenes. They’re colorful, creative, and easy to frame — perfect for bringing home a unique piece of local art with a personal touch.

🧷 Indie Art Souvenirs: | Small, original items made by independent creators: stickers, mini-prints, badges, handmade notebooks, or tiny sculptures. Each piece reflects the artist’s own style, making these souvenirs fun, expressive, and totally unique compared to typical tourist items.

places: 🎧 Record Stores in Vračar: | Vračar has several cozy record shops where you can browse through vinyls, CDs, posters, and music merch. Great for discovering local bands, classic rock, jazz, and indie finds. The vibe is friendly and creative — perfect for anyone who loves digging through music history.

🎭 Savamala Cultural Bars (non-alcoholic options available): | Savamala has artsy, music-focused venues where you’ll find live performances, DJ sets, exhibitions, and creative events. Some operate as bars with age restrictions, but many offer non-alcoholic drinks and host cultural programs like concerts, workshops, or listening sessions that are open to a wider audience.

🎺 Street Musicians Around Knez Mihailova: | Knez Mihailova’s pedestrian zone is full of musicians — guitarists, violinists, sax players, small bands, and performers from different genres. It creates a lively, street-festival feel and adds a musical backdrop to your walk through the city center.
what_to_get: 🎵 Local Vinyl Records: | Vinyl records from Belgrade’s music shops featuring local bands, classic Yugoslav rock, jazz, or modern indie artists. They’re a great collectible for music fans — a mix of cool artwork, warm sound, and a real piece of the city’s musical heritage. Even if you don’t have a record player yet, they make awesome décor and memories.

🎸 Band-Themed Crafts: | Handmade items inspired by local and regional bands — illustrated pins, stickers, mini posters, keychains, or small art pieces. These souvenirs are creative, fun, and unique, often made by independent artists. Perfect for showing off your music taste in a stylish, artsy way.

interest_descriptions.History & Fortress Views 🏰: Step into the past by walking the ancient walls of Kalemegdan, where the Sava meets the Danube — a place shaped by centuries and filled with the spirit of history.
interest_descriptions.Art & Museums 🎨: Explore a world of modern art and deep history — from futuristic installations to classical galleries, Belgrade's museums are a treat for both the curious and the creative.
interest_descriptions.River Walks 🌊: Stroll along the Sava and Danube — boats, seagulls, sunset skies, and the city noise fading into the rhythm of the river.
interest_descriptions.Nightlife 🍸: From Beton Hala to Skadarlija, Belgrade glows at night — music, lights, and vibrant gatherings, with plenty of places offering non-alcoholic drinks and epic views.
interest_descriptions.Food Exploration 😋: Taste ćevapi, ajvar, gibanica, sarma, and more — a true flavor explosion served in rustic settings with warm hospitality.
interest_descriptions.Urban Culture 🎭: Graffiti, indie galleries, live gigs, and street performers — Belgrade is a city where art and everyday life constantly mix.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Ćevapi, sarma, beans, prebranac, pies, and ajvar — soul food from the Balkans served with warmth and deep, savory flavors.
food_descriptions.Fast Food: Bakeries on every corner, pljeskavica, burek, sandwiches and quick bites — perfect for a walk-and-eat break in the city.
food_descriptions.Vegetarian: Going meat-free in Belgrade is easy — veggie soups, cheese pies, salads, bean dishes, pasta, and a creative fusion of local and modern flavors.
food_descriptions.Mixed Options: From traditional taverns to trendy bistros — the city serves up diverse meals that fit every taste and dietary need.

tour_type.morning: 🏛️ Liberty Square: Start your day right in the heart of Novi Sad — wide open square, elegant historic buildings and that soft early-morning buzz that feels super friendly. → | ⛪ Name of Mary Church: The city’s iconic neo-Gothic cathedral with bright tiles and a tall spire that totally owns the skyline. A must-see landmark. → | 🌸 Dunavska Street: One of the cutest pedestrian streets around — pastel façades, tiny shops, leafy corners and very calm ‘old town morning’ vibes. → | 🏺 Museum of Vojvodina: Quick dive into local culture — folk costumes, ancient tools, regional artifacts and stories from Novi Sad’s multicultural roots. → | ☕ Pašićeva Street Coffee Break: Cozy cafés, relaxed energy, great place to recharge before crossing the river for round two.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏰 Petrovaradin Fortress: Cross the Danube to reach the mighty ‘Gibraltar on the Danube’ — huge walls, underground tunnels, big open viewpoints and tons of history. Super fun to explore. → | 🕰️ Clock Tower: Famous for its reversed hands — the big hand shows hours! The terrace here has one of the best city panoramas, day or night. → | 🎨 Atelier Walk: Beneath the fortress, wander through small studios where local artists paint, sculpt, design and sometimes welcome visitors inside. Chill, creative and colorful. → | 🍽️ Vojvodinian Lunch: Warm soups, perkelt, štrudla and other comforting regional dishes — plus veggie-friendly choices. Rustic, cozy, super tasty.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Danube Riverside Walk (Štrand or Kej): Golden-hour magic! Štrand is lively and beachy, full of movement; Kej is chill, leafy and perfect for slow walks. Either way — amazing for photos, breezy moments and relaxed vibes.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Zmaj Jovina & Laze Telečkog (non-alcoholic friendly): The liveliest streets in the city — glowing lights, music in the distance, tons of cafés and dessert spots. Many places offer juices, lemonades, smoothies and great coffee so everyone can enjoy a safe, fun evening out.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Liberty Square → Name of Mary Church → Dunavska Street → Museum of Vojvodina → Pašićeva Street café.; Afternoon: Petrovaradin Fortress → Clock Tower → Atelier Walk → Vojvodinian lunch.; Sunset: Danube Riverside (Štrand or Kej).; Night: Zmaj Jovina & Laze Telečkog cafés with non-alcoholic options.

ideas: 🌸 Danube Park Blossoms Walk: * The park turns pastel-colored — blooming trees, quiet paths, and ducks by the pond. Perfect for soft spring photos.
🏞️ Petrovaradin Fortress Viewpoints: * The fortress is stunning in spring weather — fresh air, greenery and views that stretch along the Danube.
☕ Outdoor Cafés Near the River: * Terraces open everywhere — ideal for lemonade, iced coffee, and relaxing with river breezes.
🏖️ Štrand Beach Day: * Novi Sad’s sandy urban beach — swimming, volleyball, shade spots, and plenty of summer fun.
🌅 Sunset Views from the Fortress: * Warm colors over the Danube make Petrovaradin magical in the evening.
🍋 Cold Lemonade in Dunavska Street: * Cool down with refreshing drinks in one of the prettiest streets in the city.
🚲 Evening Biking Routes Along the Danube: * Cooling breezes, smooth paths, and beautiful riverside scenery after the heat drops.
🍂 Petrovaradin Autumn Photography: * Orange trees + fortress walls = perfect autumn compositions.
🏛️ Museum Tours: * Enjoy quiet halls and rich cultural exhibitions — ideal for cooler days.
🥐 Warm Pastries & Tea in the Old Town: * Cozy bakeries and small cafés turn Novi Sad into an autumn comfort zone.

locations: 🎄 Liberty Square Christmas Fair: * A bright festive zone with lights, wooden stalls, treats, crafts, and winter magic.
✨ Zmaj Jovina Winter Decorations: * Sparkling lights and decorated streets create the perfect holiday evening walk.

places: 🏰 Petrovaradin Fortress: | One of Europe’s largest fortifications — tunnels, ramparts and river views. A paradise for history lovers.
🏺 Museum of Vojvodina: | Artifacts, costumes, and exhibits that showcase the region’s blend of cultures and centuries of change.
⛪ Eparchy Museum: | Displays of religious art, icons, manuscripts, and items important to the region’s spiritual heritage.
what_to_get: 📮 Historical Postcards: | Vintage-style prints of old Novi Sad, Petrovaradin, and Danube views — perfect little keepsakes.
🪵 Local Craft Replicas: | Handmade items inspired by traditional Vojvodinian design — woodwork, ornaments, and folk motifs.

places: 🎨 Petrovaradin Artist Ateliers: | Dozens of studios where painters, sculptors, and designers work — a vibrant artistic community.
🏛️ Cultural Centre of Novi Sad: | Exhibitions, performances, workshops, and creative events throughout the year.
🖼️ Galleries in the Old Town: | Small, charming spaces showing local art — illustrations, paintings, ceramics, and more.
what_to_get: 🖼️ Local Artist Prints: | Unique artworks inspired by Novi Sad’s streets, fortress views, or Danube scenes.
🏺 Handmade Ceramics: | Beautiful one-of-a-kind pieces crafted by local artisans — practical and artistic souvenirs.

places: 🎶 EXIT Festival Grounds (Petrovaradin): | Visit the iconic site of one of Europe’s biggest music festivals — even outside festival time, it’s cool to explore.
🎧 Vinyl Shops in the City Center: | Browse local records, Yugoslav rock classics, jazz and indie collections.
🎤 Live-Music Cafés Near the Danube: | Riverfront spots with open-air vibes and occasional live performances (non-alcoholic options available).
what_to_get: ⭐ EXIT-Themed Souvenirs: | Posters, wristbands, stickers, and small memorabilia inspired by the famous festival.
🎸 Indie Band Merch: | Pins, mini-posters, stickers or artwork created by local indie musicians and designers.

interest_descriptions.History & Fortress Views 🏰: Petrovaradin is more than a fortress — it's a time machine above the Danube. Walk its massive walls, explore hidden tunnels, and take in views that whisper stories from centuries past.
interest_descriptions.Art & Culture 🎨: Novi Sad is a city of artists and ideas — from street murals to fortress-side studios. It breathes creativity and always offers something fresh to discover.
interest_descriptions.Nature & Park Walks 🌳: Green Novi Sad is perfect for slowing down. Danube Park, riverside paths, and tree-lined streets create peaceful pockets of calm in the middle of the city.
interest_descriptions.Food Exploration 😋: Home-style meals, strudels, stews, and regional specialties — Vojvodina’s cuisine is rich, comforting, and full of flavor. Perfect for those who love food made with heart.
interest_descriptions.Danube River Vibes 🌊: The Danube is the city’s soul. Whether you're relaxing at Štrand beach or strolling the promenade, the water, breeze, and horizon bring peace and inspiration.
interest_descriptions.Urban & Festival Culture 🎶: From EXIT Festival to street performers — Novi Sad lives for music, art, and connection. It's a city where creativity and community are part of everyday life.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Vojvodina classics like goulash, perkelt, cheese pie, strudel, and homemade soups — every dish feels warm, hearty, and full of tradition.
food_descriptions.Fast Food: Burek, sandwiches, bakery pies, grilled snacks — perfect for a tasty break while exploring the city.
food_descriptions.Vegetarian: A rich selection of meat-free options — veggie soups, pasta, fresh salads, cheese pastries, and creatively prepared local dishes made with care.
food_descriptions.Mixed Options: From old-school taverns to modern restaurants — in Novi Sad, there’s something for everyone, blending tradition with flexibility and a friendly local touch.

tour_type.morning: 🎨 City Hall & Art Nouveau Square: Start your morning exploring Subotica’s most famous pastel-colored landmarks — elegant Art Nouveau façades, decorative details and a super relaxed city vibe. → | 🕍 Synagogue: One of Europe’s most beautiful synagogues — rich patterns, warm colors and peaceful interior. A must-see architectural gem. → | 🏛️ City Museum: A friendly intro to local history, culture and Subotica’s diverse heritage. → | ☕ Korzo Café Break: Grab a cozy coffee on the main pedestrian street — street performers, soft morning energy and beautiful façades everywhere.
tour_type.afternoon: 🌊 Palić Lake Promenade: Head to Subotica’s calm lakeside escape — long promenades, breezy paths and classic Art Nouveau pavilions. Perfect for easy walking. → | 🏰 Water Tower & Grand Terrace: Beautiful old buildings with decorative details — great for photos. → | 🍽️ Vojvodina-Style Lunch: Enjoy classics like perkelt, fish soup, stuffed peppers, štrudla or veggie-friendly dishes with that special northern-Serbian warmth. → | 🌳 Palić Park Walk: Shaded lanes, swan views and peaceful greenery — a perfect slow-paced afternoon.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Sunset at Palić Lake: Golden reflections across the water, soft breeze and the most peaceful vibe you can imagine. Great spot for photos and unwinding.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Subotica Korzo & Dessert Spots (non-alcoholic options): Evening lights, relaxed café terraces, cakes, ice cream and a safe, cozy night atmosphere perfect for strolling.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: City Hall → Synagogue → City Museum → Korzo café.; Afternoon: Palić Lake → Water Tower & Grand Terrace → Vojvodina lunch → Palić park walk.; Sunset: Palić golden-hour.; Night: Korzo dessert cafés & relaxed evening stroll.

ideas: 🌸 Palić Blossoms Walk: Lakeside trees and early flowers showing off in gentle spring colors.
🎨 Art Nouveau Photo Walk: Pastel buildings look extra bright in spring sunlight.
☕ Outdoor Terraces on Korzo: Warm weather + coffee + relaxed people-watching.
🌊 Late-Afternoon Palić Walks: Breezy, calm and perfect for warm days.
🍦 Ice-Cream Spots Around the Center: Subotica has amazing gelato — perfect for cooling down.
🌳 Shade Walks in Palić Park: Natural escape from the heat with leafy paths.
🍂 Art Nouveau Streets in Fall Colors: Warm shades and unique architecture blend perfectly.
🥧 Warm Pastries & Tea on Korzo: Cozy cafés, calm weather and autumn flavors.
🏛️ Museum Visits: Explore Subotica’s multicultural history in peaceful indoor settings.

locations: 🎄 Holiday Market at the Center: Decorations, handmade crafts and festive treats.
✨ Korzo Evening Lights: Soft winter glow, warm drinks and charming cold-season vibe.

places: 🏛️ City Museum: | Collections showing Subotica’s diverse cultural past.
🕍 Synagogue: | A major historic landmark with deep architectural significance.
🎭 National Theatre Area: | A cultural hub with heritage façades and artistic stories.
what_to_get: 📜 Art Nouveau Prints: | Posters inspired by Subotica’s pastel architecture.
🏺 Local Crafts: | Handmade ornaments or folk-style ceramics.

places: 🎨 Art Nouveau Buildings: | City Hall, Raichle Palace, main square façades — pure visual joy.
🏛️ Raichle Palace Gallery: | Colorful design, exhibitions and a unique artistic vibe.
what_to_get: 🖌️ Local Artwork: | Illustrations or paintings inspired by Subotica’s architecture.
💠 Art Nouveau Souvenirs: | Small items decorated with floral or geometric patterns.

places: 🎼 Subotica Concert Hall: | Classical concerts, youth performances and cultural evenings.
🎧 Local Vinyl Shops: | Browse Yugoslav rock, Vojvodina folk, jazz and international classics.
🎺 Street Performers on Korzo: | Summer nights often bring live music to the pedestrian zone.
what_to_get: ⭐ Local Music Merch: | Posters, pins or stickers from Subotica’s cultural venues.
📀 Regional Folk CDs: | Traditional sounds from northern Serbia.

interest_descriptions.Art Nouveau Architecture 🎨: Subotica is famous for its pastel colors, ornate details and elegant European charm — a dream for architecture lovers and photographers.
interest_descriptions.Lakeside Views 🌊: With calm promenades and breezy paths, Palić Lake is Subotica’s peaceful escape just minutes from the city.
interest_descriptions.Local Food Exploration 😋: Vojvodina is all about comfort food — gentle spices, warm soups, pastries and classic northern-Serbian dishes.
interest_descriptions.Parks & Nature 🌳: Whether in Palić Park or smaller green corners in the city, Subotica is full of shade, soft trails and relaxing scenery.
interest_descriptions.Urban Culture 🎭: From the pedestrian Korzo to colorful cultural spots, Subotica blends history, European elegance and chill modern lifestyle.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Classic Vojvodina comfort food — perkelt, fish soup, stuffed peppers, štrudla and gentle, home-style flavors.
food_descriptions.Fast Food: Quick bites include pizza cuts, grilled sandwiches, pitas and pastries perfect for exploring on foot.
food_descriptions.Vegetarian: Plenty of options — veggie stews, grilled vegetables, pastries, salads and mild northern-style dishes.
food_descriptions.Mixed Options: Cafés and restaurants across the city offer a mix of traditional meals, international bites and flexible dietary choices.

tour_type.morning: 🌳 Main Street (Zelena Ulica): Start your day with Sombor’s iconic tree-lined boulevard — peaceful, green, elegant and perfect for a soft city warm-up. → | 🏛️ County Hall (Županija): Visit the famous building that houses *the largest oil painting in Serbia* — 'Boji Presečene' — plus grand halls and gorgeous architecture. → | 🖼️ Sombor National Museum: A friendly cultural stop featuring Bačka history, artworks and local heritage. → | ☕ Café Under the Linden Trees: Enjoy a slow morning coffee in a cozy street café shaded by Sombor’s famous tall trees.
tour_type.afternoon: 🌿 Sombor City Park: One of Serbia’s oldest and greenest parks — wide paths, calm corners and endless shade. Perfect for relaxing. → | 🚲 Bicycle Ride to the Great Bačka Canal: Gentle scenic cycling routes with peaceful canalside views. → | 🍽️ Bačka-Style Lunch: Try perkelt, čorbe, štrudla, pasta-like local dishes, or veggie-friendly meals — mild, homestyle flavors. → | 🎨 Milan Konjović Gallery: Explore colorful expressionist works of one of Serbia’s most famous painters.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Great Bačka Canal Promenade: Golden light over calm water, soft reflections and a gentle breeze — ideal for golden-hour photos and slow walking.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Sombor Center & Dessert Spots: Relaxed cafés, cake shops, soft lighting and a friendly small-town evening vibe — all with plenty of teen-friendly drink options.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Zelena Street → County Hall → Sombor Museum → Linden-shade café.; Afternoon: City Park → Canal cycling → Bačka lunch → Konjović Gallery.; Sunset: Canal golden-hour walk.; Night: Center dessert cafés & peaceful evening stroll.

ideas: 🌸 Blooming City Park Walk: Fresh flowers, bright trees and gentle March–May breeze.
🚲 Spring Cycling Routes: Perfect temperature for easy biking around the canals.
☕ Outdoor Terraces: Cafés open their shaded patios for chill spring mornings.
🌳 Deep-Shade Park Escapes: Sombor’s huge linden trees = natural air conditioning.
🍦 Ice Cream on Kralja Petra Street: The perfect cooldown for hot afternoons.
🌊 Sunset at the Canal: Bright, warm and breezy — best time of day in summer.
🍂 Golden Streets of Zelena Ulica: Falling leaves + pastel buildings = autumn postcards.
🥧 Cozy Pastry & Tea Spots: Warm strudels, pies and peaceful cafés.
🏛️ Museum & Gallery Visits: Perfect time to explore culture without crowds.

locations: 🎄 Center Holiday Lights: Gentle decorations, local stalls and winter charm.
✨ Evening Café Corners: Warm drinks, soft lights and a peaceful cold-season atmosphere.

places: 🏛️ County Hall: | A major historic landmark with grand halls and important art.
🏺 City Museum: | Archaeology, ethnography and regional heritage collections.
🏡 Old Bačka Houses: | Quiet heritage streets with traditional architecture.
what_to_get: 📜 Art Prints of Sombor Landmarks: | Zelena Ulica, County Hall, Konjović paintings.
🏺 Handmade Local Crafts: | Folk-inspired ceramics or ornaments.

places: 🎨 Milan Konjović Gallery: | Colorful works of the famous expressionist.
🖼️ City Museum Art Sections: | Regional painters and historical artworks.
📷 Art Nouveau Corners: | Photogenic building façades around the center.
what_to_get: 🖌️ Local Artwork: | Prints or small originals from regional artists.
🎨 Colorful Souvenirs: | Items inspired by Konjović’s bold palette.

places: 🎼 Cultural Center Concerts: | Classical, local and youth performances.
🎧 Vinyl Shops & Bookstores: | Small shops with regional music and old records.
🎺 Street Music on Korzo (seasonal): | Friendly small-town performances.
what_to_get: ⭐ Local Music Postcards: | Minimalist designs featuring Sombor culture.
📀 Regional Folk CDs: | Traditional Bačka melodies.

interest_descriptions.Art & Culture 🎨: Sombor is full of museums, galleries and beautifully preserved architecture — perfect for art lovers and history explorers.
interest_descriptions.Nature & Green Spaces 🌳: Known as one of Serbia’s greenest cities, Sombor offers deep-shade parks, quiet paths and calm canal walks.
interest_descriptions.Local Food Exploration 😋: Bačka’s cuisine is hearty and comforting — soups, slow-cooked dishes, pastries and mild, homey flavors.
interest_descriptions.Relaxed Small-Town Vibes 🏡: From linden-lined streets to pastel façades, Sombor feels peaceful, cozy and refreshingly slow-paced.
interest_descriptions.Cycling & Easy Walks 🚲: Flat terrain and scenic routes make Sombor perfect for relaxed cycling and gentle outdoor exploring.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Northern-Serbian comfort food — fish soup, perkelt, stuffed peppers, štrudla and mild, home-style flavors.
food_descriptions.Fast Food: Bakeries, sandwiches, pizza cuts and quick bites ideal for exploring on the go.

interest_descriptions.Relaxed Walks & Photography 📷: Every corner is scenic — bridges, gardens, fountains and nature-filled viewpoints.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Warm soups, roasted vegetables, homemade pastries and traditional Šumadija dishes with mild, comforting flavors.
food_descriptions.Fast Food: Crepes, waffles, pastries, pizza slices and easy snack spots near the promenade.
food_descriptions.Vegetarian: Plenty of salads, veggie stews, baked dishes and mild spa-style meals.
food_descriptions.Mixed Options: Restaurants offer a mix of classic Šumadija cooking and modern light dishes.

tour_type.morning: 🏔️ Tornik Viewpoint: Start your day with fresh mountain air and wide-open panoramas from Zlatibor’s highest peak — a peaceful and breathtaking morning scene. → | 🚠 Gondola Ride (Gold Gondola): Enjoy a scenic ride over forests, meadows and Ribničko Lake — super calming, super photogenic. → | 🌿 Ribničko Lake Walk: Gentle lakeside stroll with wooden piers, quiet paths and soft early-morning light. → | ☕ Mountain Cottage Café: Warm drink in a cozy wooden lodge — pure Zlatibor vibe.
tour_type.afternoon: 🏡 Stopića Cave (light exploration): Impressive natural formation with easy paths and magical stone pools — fun and accessible for all ages. → | 🏘️ Sirogojno (Old Village Museum): Open-air museum full of traditional wooden houses, crafts and gentle village atmosphere. → | 🍽️ Zlatibor-Style Lunch: Try baked dishes, warm soups, roasted vegetables, komplet-lepinja (non-greasy version available), or veggie-friendly meals — homely and comforting. → | 🛍️ Local Handcraft Shops: Wool products, wooden carvings, natural creams, cute mountain souvenirs.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Obudojevica Hill: Soft golden light over open meadows, pine forests and resort rooftops — peaceful and perfect for photography.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Zlatibor Center Night Walk (non-alcoholic): Lights, dessert places, waffles, pancakes, ice cream, calm music — lively but safe and cozy nighttime energy.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: Tornik → Gondola → Ribničko Lake → Cottage café.; Afternoon: Stopića Cave → Sirogojno → Zlatibor lunch → Handcraft shops.; Sunset: Obudojevica hill.; Night: Center dessert cafés & chill walk.

interest_descriptions.Mountain Views & Nature 🏔️: Zlatibor is full of open meadows, rolling hills, pine forests and bright skies — pure mountain freedom.
interest_descriptions.Outdoor Adventures 🚶‍♂️: Light hikes, scenic rides and fun nature zones make Zlatibor perfect for easygoing adventure days.
interest_descriptions.Relaxation & Lakes 🌿: Ribničko Lake and calm mountain corners bring soft, peaceful, slow-living energy.
interest_descriptions.Local Food Exploration 😋: Warm southern-mountain dishes — from baked meals to gentle dairy and veggie options.
interest_descriptions.Traditional Villages & Culture 🏡: Sirogojno and surrounding areas preserve old wooden architecture, crafts and authentic mountain heritage.

food_descriptions.Local Specialties: Mountain-style meals — soups, roasted veggies, pite, kačkavalj, baked dishes, all warm and comforting.

tour_type.morning: 🏞️ Golubac Peak (Golubac): Start your day with a gentle climb toward one of Divčibare’s classic viewpoints — soft morning light, open meadows and a chill forest breeze. → | 🌲 Forest Path Walk: Continue through pine-scented trails — relaxing, quiet and perfect for a slow exploration. → | 🏔️ Crni Vrh Viewpoint: A short additional walk brings you to another beautiful lookout with panoramic views over the mountains. → | ☕ Mountain Café Break: Cozy terrace with warm drinks, wooden décor and peaceful atmosphere.
tour_type.afternoon: 🌿 Maljen Meadows Long Walk: Wide, open grassy fields ideal for relaxed walking, playing around or taking scenic photos. → | 🌊 Paklina Stream Area: Calm nature zone with light bubbling water and shade — super peaceful. → | 🍽️ Divčibare-Style Lunch: Warm soups, roasted vegetables, baked dishes, pite, kačkavalj and veggie-friendly options — comforting and homemade. → | 🛍️ Small Souvenir Corners: Mini shops offering wooden crafts, knitted items and nature-inspired pieces.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Paljba Lookout: A lesser-known viewpoint with golden light spilling over hills and forests — calm, dreamy and photogenic.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Divčibare Center Night Walk (non-alcoholic): Soft lights, waffles, pancakes, ice cream and a peaceful alpine vibe — safe, cozy and friendly.
